## Release Highlights

#### ❗ Security updates
#### 🔧 Improved coinjoin stability
#### 🌙 Payjoin discontinued

## Release Summary
Wasabi Wallet v2.8.5 includes security updates and polishes the coinjoin feature.

### ❗ Security updates
Updates dependencies to address disclosed vulnerabilities & adds stricter transaction verification to protect against malicious servers.

### 🔧 Improved coinjoin stability
Fixes an edge case where clients would fail to construct outputs. Inputs from partially signed coinjoins containing payments are now prioritized for the next round. Amounts below 10,000 sats can no longer be queued for coinjoin payments and get stuck.

### 🌙 Payjoin discontinued
Support for sending BIP78 payjoin transactions was removed to reduce code complexity and attack surface.

### Deprecation of compatibility passphrase feature
Please create a new wallet if you see the following message while logging in to your wallet:
*Compatibility passphrase was used! Please consider generating a new wallet to ensure recoverability!*

Five years ago, because of a clipboard bug on macOS in the Avalonia UI framework, users who created wallets by pasting complex passwords (with non-ASCII characters) got their passphrase silently truncated and corrupted. Wallets created with the buggy passphrase would be unrecoverable using standard BIP39 tools. The mechanism for working around that issue will soon be removed.

## Installation Guide
Download the operating system relevant software package and install Wasabi like you would with any other software on your computer.
For a detailed installation guide, including **signature verification**, see [the documentation](https://docs.wasabiwallet.io/using-wasabi/InstallPackage.html).

## Advanced Guide
If you want to build or update Wasabi from source code, check out [these easy instructions](https://docs.wasabiwallet.io/using-wasabi/BuildSource.html).

Wasabi uses [reproducible builds](https://reproducible-builds.org/), which you can verify with [this guide](https://github.com/WalletWasabi/WalletWasabi/blob/master/WalletWasabi.Documentation/Guides/DeterministicBuildGuide.md).
